info.name: Benchling AA Sequences Assay Results API

params.name: schemaId
params.description: ID of the assay result schema to filter by

params.name: createdAt.lt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created before the specified time. e.g. < 2017-04-30.

params.name: createdAt.gt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created after the specified time. e.g. > 2017-04-30.

params.name: createdAt.lte
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created on or before the specified time. e.g. <= 2017-04-30.

params.name: createdAt.gte
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those created on or after the specified time. e.g. >= 2017-04-30.

params.name: minCreatedTime
params.description: Filter by results created after this unix timestamp

params.name: maxCreatedTime
params.description: Filter by results created before this unix timestamp

params.name: sort
params.description: Method by which to order search results. Valid sorts are createdAt (created time, oldest first). Use :asc or :desc to specify ascending or descending order. Default is createdAt:asc.

params.name: nextToken
params.description: Token for pagination

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50, maximum of 100.

params.name: entityIds
params.description: Filter by comma-separated list of related Entity IDs, maximum of 20.

params.name: storageIds
params.description: Filter by comma-separated list of related inventory (container, box, plate, or location) IDs, maximum of 20.

params.name: assayRunIds
params.description: Filter by comma-separated list of associated AssayRun IDs. At most one of {assayRunIds, automationOutputProcessorId} may be supplied.

params.name: automationOutputProcessorId
params.description: Filter by Automation Output Processor ID. Either this or schemaId is required; if both are given, the associated schemas must match. At most one of {assayRunIds, automationOutputProcessorId} may be supplied.

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of ids. Matches all of the provided IDs, or returns a 400 error that includes a list of which IDs are invalid.

params.name: modifiedAt.lt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified before the specified time. e.g. < 2017-04-30.

params.name: modifiedAt.gt
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified after the specified time. e.g. > 2017-04-30.

params.name: modifiedAt.lte
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified on or before the specified time. e.g. <= 2017-04-30.

params.name: modifiedAt.gte
params.description: Datetime, in RFC 3339 format. Time zone defaults to UTC. Restricts results to those modified on or after the specified time. e.g. >= 2017-04-30.

params.name: archiveReason
params.description: Archive reason. Restricts items to those with the specified archive reason. Use "NOT_ARCHIVED" to filter for unarchived Assay Results. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED" to filter for archived Assay Results regardless of reason. Use "ANY_ARCHIVED_OR_NOT_ARCHIVED" to return items for both archived and unarchived.

items.docs:
Create 1 or more results.
If you are looking to add results to a specific table in a notebook entry, please use the  [assay-results bulk-create](#/Assay%20Results/bulkCreateAssayResults) endpoint instead.
Results that have been added to a Legacy Result or Legacy Run table in a Notebook Entry **cannot** be Archived.
Bulk create results. Limit of 4000 results per request.

info.name: Gets multiple results specified by a list of IDs.

params.name: assayResultIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of assay result IDs.

items.docs: Up to 200 IDs can be specified at once.

Transactions allow results to be upload in multiple requests. This endpoint lets you create a transaction. You can then upload results to the transaction, abort the transaction, or commit the transaction.
Aborting a transaction will discard all uploaded results.
Committing a transaction will cause all results that have been uploaded to be saved and visible to others.
